title: Selling Plans Schedule of Fee Credit and Fee Dispute Limits
content:
This schedule lists the figures behind fee credits and fee disputes on **Selling Plans**. Every figure is identical on the Individual Seller Plan and on the Starter, Basic, Premium, Anchor and Enterprise Store.

| Item | Figure on every Selling Plans tier |
|---|---|
| Refund administration fee rate (share of a variable final value fee credit withheld) | 20% |
| Refund administration fee cap (maximum per credited order) | USD 5.00 |
| How the variable fee credit is sized on a partial refund | In proportion to the refunded share of the fee basis |
| Per-order fee credited when the whole order is refunded | Yes |
| Refund credit window (calendar days after the order date) | 180 days |
| Refund administration fee waived when the order is cancelled before shipment | Yes |
| Fee dispute window (calendar days after the fee's billing date) | 90 days |
| Disputes that may be filed on one fee record | 1 |

## Reading the schedule

- **Rate and cap together (hypothetical figures).** Twenty per cent of a USD 18.00 credit is USD 3.60, which is under the USD 5.00 cap; twenty per cent of a USD 40.00 credit is USD 8.00, which the cap holds to USD 5.00.
- **One dispute per fee record.** The limit is counted per fee record: a seller with three fee records may file one dispute on each of them.
